task_text: Throw or put all four plastic bottles into the bin. Success: all 4 bottles are inside the bin at the same time: each bottle's centre of mass within the bin's inner wall radius of the bin's axis, not below the bin's floor, and at most about 0.11 m (a little over half a bottle length) above its rim (a bottle may still be held). The goal must hold for 30 consecutive control steps (1.02 s); the episode then ends in success.
